newsitem.title: JAPAN: JNR SAYS MYCAL UNIT TO BUY LAND FOR 10.9 BLN YEN.
newsitem.headline: JNR SAYS MYCAL UNIT TO BUY LAND FOR 10.9 BLN YEN.

text.p: JNR Settlement Corp said on Monday that it would sell a parcel of land in central Osaka to a wholly owned subsidiary of Mycal Corp for 10.9 billion yen.
The corporation on Friday announced the result of its auction for three tracts of prime land in Osaka but did not unveil the Mycal unit's bid price at that time.
The Mycal unit won one of the lots but two other properties failed to sell at that time as no offers matched the minimum price set by JNR Settlement, the corporation said.
The Mycal group plans to invest about 40 billion yen to build a commercial complex on the land, which will include shops, offices and other facilities, the corporation said.
On Monday, JNR Settlement said that a real estate affiliate of Kinki Nippon Railway Co Ltd would buy one of the two unsold properties. It did not give the value of the deal.
The Kinki affiliate declined to comment on its price but said it planned to invest a total of 20 billion yen to redevelop the area.
The other lot failed to sell, the corporation said.
JNR Settlement was set up in 1987 to sell off many of the assets owned by the now-defunct Japan National Railways when it was split up into seven regional companies.
